title: Labeling of Extracellular Vesicles for Monitoring Migration and Uptake in Cartilage Explants
protocol: Equilibrate the column according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Remove the column cap and equilibrate the column.
Elute and remove the storage buffer from the column.
Wash the column three times with 2.5 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Wait for the column to absorb each wash volume completely.
Cover the column with the cap after the final wash until sample preparation.
Do not allow the column to dry at any point during washing or before use.
Concentrate the EV sample and the control using a concentrating tube.
Place samples in a 15 mL or 500 µL concentrating tube based on starting volume.
Centrifuge the tubes according to the manufacturer's instructions until an almost-dry sample is obtained.
Resuspend concentrated samples with diluent C.
Transfer EV samples resuspended in 200 μL to new 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes.
Transfer control group samples resuspended in 100 μL to new 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes.
Separate the EV sample into two aliquots of 100 µL each.
Mark one EV aliquot with dye for treatment (PKH-PL-EV).
Prepare a volume of 2x dye solution, resulting in an 8 µM PKH26 solution in diluent C.
Mix 1 μL of 1 mM PKH26 linker per 125 µL of diluent C to prepare the dye solution.
Add 2x dye solution to PKH-PL-EV and control samples in a 1:1 ratio to achieve 4 µM PKH26 concentration.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature.
Add 5% bovine serum albumin-PBS solution to the samples in a 1:1 ratio, ensuring a final volume of ~400 μL.
Remove cap from column and add 400 µL of sample (PKH-PL-EV, NTA-PL-EV, or control).
Discard all eluted liquid after adding sample to the column.
Add 600 µL of PBS and discard all eluted liquid.
Wait for the PBS to enter the column completely before proceeding.
Add 600 µL of PBS and collect a fraction of 600 µL in a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Prepare the column for a new EV separation step to obtain purer EVs.
If it is a new column, repeat steps 2.1 and 2.2.
If it is the same column, wash the column with 2.5 mL of 20% isopropanol and then repeat steps 2.1 and 2.2.
Add 600 µL of previously eluted EVs obtained in step 2.5 to the column and discard the eluted volume.
Wait for the liquid to enter the column completely before proceeding.
Add 400 µL of PBS and discard all eluted volume.
Wait for the liquid to enter the column completely before proceeding.
Add 600 µL of PBS and collect a fraction of 600 µL in a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Use the EVs and control samples for further analyses or store them overnight at 4 °C.
Store the used columns for future use.
Wash the column with 25 mL of 20% isopropanol and discard the eluted volume.
Wash the column 3 times with 2.5 mL of PBS.
Add the storage buffer removed in step 1.1.1 and wait for the buffer to enter the column.
Cover the column with the cap and store at 4°C until subsequent use.
Prepare 1 mL of 1:10 diluted NTA-PL-EV sample using PBS filtered through a 0.2 µm filter.
Prepare 1 mL of 1:10 diluted initial PL-EV sample using PBS filtered through a 0.2 µm filter.
Prepare 1 mL of 1:100 dilution of the previous NTA-PL-EV samples with PBS filtered through a 0.2 µm filter.
Prepare 1 mL of 1:100 dilution of the previous initial PL-EV samples with PBS filtered through a 0.2 µm filter.
Inject the 1:1,000 diluted NTA-PL-EV sample using a sterile syringe into the NTA pump.
Follow manufacturer's instructions for particle concentration and size distribution determination.
Wash the cartilage twice with PBS under sterile conditions.
Excise the cartilage using a 3 mm diameter biopsy punch under sterile conditions.
Place the explants in 96-well culture plates containing DMEM-F12 medium supplemented with 1% penicillin-streptomycin at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 80% humidity.
Treat the explants with 1 × 109 particles/well of labeled EVs or control in cell culture medium supplemented with oncostatin M and TNFα.
Measure the volume of the sample containing 1 × 109 particles/well and use the same volume for the control.
Remove the medium from the 96-well cell culture plates containing cartilage explants.
Add 200 µL of cell culture medium to each well.
Wash each well three times with 200 µL of PBS if in contact with fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Stop the in vitro assay at different times: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 h.
Wash the cell culture wells containing the cartilage explants twice with 200 µL of PBS.
Add 100 µL of 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) to fix the tissue for 3 h at 4 °C.
Remove the PFA, add 100 µL of PBS.
Store the fixed tissue at 4 °C and process the samples within 48 h.
Embed the fixed tissues in paraffin blocks.
Cut the tissue into 6 µm-thick sections.
Deparaffinize the tissue sections in xylene for 30 min.
Immerse the tissue sections in 100% ethanol for 2 min.
Immerse the tissue sections in 96% ethanol for 2 min.
Immerse the tissue sections in 75% ethanol for 1 min.
Wash each section in distilled water for 30 s.
Prepare a 0.1% Triton-0.1% sodium citrate solution.
Add a 20 μL drop of permeabilizing solution to each tissue section.
Incubate the tissue sections with permeabilizing solution for 10 min at room temperature.
Wash each section twice with 20 μL of PBS.
On a microscopic slide, add a drop of mounting medium containing DAPI.
Cover the slide containing 3 tissue sections.
Incubate the slides overnight at room temperature, protected from light.
Store the slides at 4 °C, protected from light until confocal microscopy.
